stories.title: Thirteen hospitalized after charter bus crash on I-55 in southwest suburbs
stories.summary: Thirteen people were hospitalized after a crash involving a charter bus on I-55 in the southwest suburbs on Thursday afternoon, Illinois State Police said. Around 1:55 p.m., a crash occurred between a charter bus and another vehicle on I-55 near Clarendon Hills Road in Willowbroo
